name: Vespertine Decay
body:
School necromancy; Level cleric/oracle 4, death mage 4, inquisitor 4, paladin 3, shaman 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, white necromancer 4, witch 4

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 20 ft.
Area 20-ft.-emanation centered on you
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Fortitude half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create an aura that causes degradation to any creature lurking in the dark. At the beginning of your turn, creatures in dim light take 3d4 damage. Creatures in darkness or creatures with the shadow subtype instead take 3d6 damage. A successful Fortitude save halves this damage. You are also affected by the spell if in an area of dim light or darker.
